verdict.rationale: Trivy's own docs say it scans container images for license files and gives an opinionated risk view of each license, which covers license detection with risk categorization. Nothing in the pack shows enforcing a custom license policy, such as allow/deny lists or failing a scan on forbidden licenses. Missing for 10: documented license-policy enforcement (allow/deny or fail-on-violation), explicit per-dependency license detection beyond license files in images, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans

citations.quote: Trivy scans any container image for license files and offers an opinionated view on the risk associated with the license.
